page.layout: One page of running text, with the running head at the top centre. Below the text: the closing formula in italic, the closing word "Addictissimus," and the initials "S. G. S." set on separate lines. A small mark at the bottom centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: coque stylo conscriptam offero. Hunc autem ordinem sequutus sum. Ad me pervenerunt varia earundem prælectionum collectanea, præcipue vero exemplar ab ornatiss. viro D. Adamo Thobelski, C.T. præceptore, mihi liberaliter suppeditatum est, eius propria manu diligentissimè, & Neostadii, paulo ante mortem D. Vrsini, exceptum.Illo, meoque cum aliis exemplaribus fideliter collatis, in hunc codicem commentarios catecheticos D. Vrsini retuli, quod Deus benè vertat, cuius gloriæ inservire fuit animus. Quòd autem, Generose Comes, tibi alienos labores consecrare visum est, non indignè ferent, qui consilii mei rationes expendere dignabuntur: quarum prior est, ipsius Vrsini, dum vixit, erga te singularis benevolentia, quæ nobile nomen tuum Theologicis laboribus, quos reverenter colis, inscribere iubet. Altera, quum doctissimi tui præceptoris laudabili studio, è scriniis tuis tam præclarum opus in lucem exeat, quis mihi vitio vertet, si præclarum istud opus, veluti tuum tibi vendicem? quod ut dextra manu, & ceu genuinum Vrsini posthumum accipias, C.T. vehementer etiam atque etiam rogo. Genevæ .15. Calend. Aprilis. Anno patientiæ Dei. 1584.

page.notes: Printed text is in roman type throughout, with a few italic words. "Quòd" carries a grave accent as printed; the "Quod" above it is underlined in the scan. Long s normalised to s. "exceptum.Illo" is printed without a space after the stop. ".15." is printed with a spaced "1 5", read here as 15. The small mark at the bottom centre is uncertain and may be a gathering signature or show-through. No page number is printed.
